title: evals-quality-scratchpad-regression-notes-2026-04-20
content:
Quick scratchpad for the quality/regression observations from the 2026-04-19 rollout (redwood-instruct-v2 -> redwood-instruct-v2a).

Goal: capture ad-hoc rubric, a few concrete sample failures, initial hypotheses, and next steps. Save as a personal working note before formalizing into a ticket or Confluence writeup.

SUMMARY:
- After promoting redwood-instruct-v2a as default for hosted-chat, we saw a ~2.7% drop in pass@1 for the internal customer-support benchmark and an increase in hallucination rate for slot-filling prompts.
- Latency and token-efficiency unchanged (batching/kv-caching same config).
- Regression appears concentrated on short-context, factual QA + constrained extraction tasks.

AD-HOC RUBRIC (for quick triage):
1 — Fail: wrong/confabbed answer or missed required slot; harmful or clearly incorrect.
2 — Low: answer incomplete/partially correct; misses edge info but salvageable with small prompt changes.
3 — Medium: correct but verbose or has minor extraneous content.
4 — Good: concise and correct; matches reference.

SAMPLE PROMPTS & OUTPUTS (gold / v2 / v2a):
1) Prompt: "Customer asks: What is the refund window for annual subscriptions?"
   - Reference: "30 days from purchase for annual subscriptions."
   - redwood-instruct-v2: "You can request a refund within 30 days of purchase for annual plans." (score 4)
   - redwood-instruct-v2a: "Refund policy depends on region; usually 14 days for some countries, contact support for exceptions." (score 1)
   Notes: v2a hallucinated region-dependent clause; policy in our docs is a flat 30 days for annual.

2) Prompt: "Extract order_id and total from: "Order 88321 — total $42.50 — placed 2026-03-18"
   - Reference: order_id=88321; total=42.50
   - v2: "order_id=88321; total=42.50" (4)
   - v2a: "order=88321; amount=$42.50; date=2026-03-18" (3)
   Notes: parsing fine but inconsistent key names (order vs order_id) — downstream integration brittle.

3) Prompt: short factual QA: "Who is the current VP of Sales?" (internal org chart)
   - Reference: "Avery Nguyen"
   - v2: "Avery Nguyen" (4)
   - v2a: "It might be Avery Nguyen or possibly Riley Harper, check org chart" (2)
   Notes: v2a hedges instead of answering; reduces automation value for simple lookup tasks.

REGRESSION PATTERN HYPOTHESES:
- Temperature / decoding behavior: default sampling params may have shifted; v2a may favor cautious/hedging tokens. Check default top_p/temperature in model spec.
- Instruction tuning change: v2a appears to prioritize conservative phrasing for ambiguous prompts, which causes incorrect hedging for unambiguous internal facts.
- Tokenizer mismatch or special tokens handling: for short factual answers might be introducing extra tokens or segmentation causing completion truncation or qualifier insertion.
- Post-processing changes in the serving layer (we recently added a whitespace normalization step in PR #891). Verify rollout timeline vs regression start.

QUICK DIAGNOSTIC STEPS (what I ran / to run):
- Re-run failing prompts with identical generation params on both models via local eval harness (done 2026-04-20): reproduced.
- Check model config diffs between v2 and v2a: open PR with model card changes (TODO).
- Run 1k-sample focused eval on support-bench (short-context subset) to quantify impact and confidence intervals.
- Look at token-level logits for a couple examples to see whether model assigns probability mass to hedging tokens.
- Replay requests from prod trace sampling to reproduce in serving environment (trace ids: avail in linked Confluence page).

NOTES FOR TICKET / OWNER SUGGESTION:
- Priority: P1 for Hosted customers using support-bench workflows (automation break).
- Proposed immediate mitigation: pin hosted default back to redwood-instruct-v2 for affected route(s) OR enable conservative fallback policy (if response fails regex/schema then call fallback model).
- Owner suggestion: @Maya Patel to validate model config diffs, @Jordan Lee to check serving changes/PR #891. I can assemble evaluation artifacts and sample traces.

NEXT STEPS (my TODOs):
- [ ] Run 1k short-context eval and attach CSV. (target 2026-04-22)
- [ ] Diff model cards and training/instruction datasets for v2 vs v2a.
- [ ] Check serving release notes around 2026-04-18 for any decoding/postprocess changes.
- [ ] Draft ENG-1423 with examples, logs, and suggested rollback/fallback.

THINGS TO WATCH / QUESTIONS FOR ML RESEARCH:
- If it's instruction-tuning changes, can we prompt-engineer a shim prompt to force concise factual answers? Test by prepending "Answer succinctly with exact values only:"
- If it's sampling defaults, what's the minimal config change that restores parity without hurting other tasks?

SHARED LINKS / ARTIFACTS (for convenience):
- Confluence summary draft: https://confluence.redwood.ai/display/EVALS/llm-regression-investigation
- Prod ticket placeholder: ENG-1423
- Serving PR that overlapped deploy: https://github.com/redwood-inference/serving-runtime/pull/891

Notes-to-self: keep this loose — formalize after 1k eval and token-log inspection.

-- Sam
